description: Erection of matching side and rear roof dormer extensions and one matching front roof light to the semi-detached houses.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications:  FDB-24VA AP201, FDB-24VA AP202, FDB-24VA AP203, FDB-24VA AP204 (1), FDB-24VA AP204, FDB-24VA AP205, FDB-24VA AP303, FDB-24VA AP304, FDB-24VA AP305, FDB-24VA AP403, FDB-24VA AP405, FDB-24VA AP406, FDB-24VA AP407, FDB-24VA AP502, FDB-24VA AP503, FDB-24VA AP511 Received: 09 June 2026;  FDB-24VA AE001, FDB-24VA AE101, FDB-24VA AE102, FDB-24VA AE103, FDB-24VA AE104, FDB-24VA AE301, FDB-24VA AE302, FDB-24VA AE303, FDB-24VA AE401, FDB-24VA AE402, FDB-24VA AE501, FDB-24VA P801 Received: 16 April 2026.  

Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing houses, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.

Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or openings shall be formed in the elevations and roofs of the development hereby permitted.

Reason: In order to protect neighbours' privacy.

Condition : 5 - The windows formed in the side roof dormer extensions hereby permitted shall be obscure glazed and non-opening below 1.7 metres above finished internal floor level.  The windows shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than in accordance with the requirements of this condition.

Reason: In order to protect neighbours' privacy.

Condition : 6 - The installation of matching front roof lights and erection of matching side and rear roof dormer extensions hereby permitted shall not be partly or fully implemented to either Nos. 2 or 4 Vaughan Avenue without the full development hereby permitted being simultaneously implemented and fully completed to both houses within one year of the development hereby permitted being implemented to either house.  

Reasons:  To protect the symmetrical design of the semi-detached houses and the character and appearance of the Conservation Area, in accordance with Local Plan Policies SC7, CC1, CC2 and CC4 and the Character, Sustainability and Design Codes SPD: Residential Extension Guidelines.
